articles.title: Voter Guide Meet the Judicial Candidates on the Nov Ballot
articles.excerpt: The court was created in the 2023 legislative session, and its three inaugural justices are on the ballot for the first time in 2026 (San Antonio Report).

articles.title: Texas Supreme Court Criminal Appeals Results Elections
articles.excerpt: Nov. 3, 2026 result: Scott Brister lost the race for Fifteenth Court of Appeals, Chief Justice with 4,636,992 votes (48.2%); opponent: Jerry Zimmerer (D) 4,985,001 (51.8%), in unofficial returns (Texas Secretary of State; The Texas Tribune).
